name: Jeffrey
legendaryBio: Though the monarchs have often proven insurmountable, this challenger faces them anew with each dawn, their spirit forged in the fires of countless, valiant attempts to reclaim the fallen crowns. Their legend speaks not of victories, but of an unbreakable will against the might of the Royal Court.

name: Frank
legendaryBio: Though the crown has ever slipped from their grasp, the Uncrowned Pretender tirelessly seeks to dismantle the reign of kings, their spirit unbowed by countless defeats. Every game of Regicide is another testament to their enduring, albeit often fruitless, ambition.

name: Richard
legendaryBio: Though the gods of fortune have never graced him with a win, his legend grows through the sheer tenacity of a spirit that refuses to yield to the bitterness of defeat.
